main_measure.name: mean 20-bar forward return on short bars minus on all bars (pp)
main_measure.threshold: Confirm if the difference is <= -2 percentage points with Welch t <= -2; reject if the difference is >= 0

supporting_check.name: short-bar share of negative 20-bar returns minus all-bar share (pp), needs >= 10

decided_by: The hit rate on short bars is not above the unconditional share of negative 20-bar returns.
reading: Short bars are the 20-bar grid bars (positions 0, 20, 40, ... of each window) with forecast < 0, compared against all grid bars; the largest-tertile shorts are the ceil(n/3) short cases with the most negative forecast; the threshold for 'not above' in the hit rate is a difference of 0 or less; and the minimum count is checked first, then the reject rules, then the confirm rule.
